Second, from Chart 4, the proportion of Asian adults living near or below the poverty line who had trouble paying bills is 42% (chart_4-5), and those living above the poverty line is 17% (chart_4-6). The difference is 42% - 17% = 25%. The ratio is 264000 / 101000 ≈ 2.61. Fourth, from Chart 6, the proportion of Asian adults living near or below the poverty line who say the American dream is out of reach is 47% (chart_6-1), and those living above the poverty line is 26% (chart_6-2).
